Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Supplies check, assign and show hooks for a configuration parameter defined at run time with
[PgGucRegistry](/api/ankus.pggucregistry/), as pgrx's <code>define_*_guc_with_hooks</code> functions accept hook functions.

```csharp
public sealed class PgGucHooks<T>
```

Type parameters:

`T`

The parameter's value type: [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean), [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32), [double](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.double), a nullable
[string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string), or the [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32) value of an enumerated parameter's label.

<p>
The hooks follow the rules for the hooks a [PgGucAttribute](/api/ankus.pggucattribute/) names: a check can normalize or reject a
proposed value and attach [PgGucExtra](/api/ankus.pggucextra/), assign runs before PostgreSQL changes the value and must not
fail, and show returns display text. Leave a hook null to omit it.
</p>
<p>
An extension can define at most 64 parameters with hooks. Defining a parameter again, as a retried module load
does, must pass the same hook methods.
</p>
